newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * European Commission President Jacques Santer started a visit to Romania and met Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
He is to speak to both chambers of parliament and meet President Emil Constantinescu in the afternoon. Santer and Constantinescu are to give a joint news conference in the evening.
* Economic and financial crimes almost doubled in Bucharest in the first quarter against the same period last year, Bucharest police chief Viorel Ardeleanu told a news conference.
He said closer cooperation with the Finance Ministry's monitoring unit would allow policemen to uncover more fraud cases. -- Bucharest newsroom 40-1 3120264
